payload.claim: The reworded comment says 'A refusal is caught above now, so this is Ctrl-C or a dead runtime,' but the try block this except BaseException closes spans the whole rest of _drive_cell (from cell_up through plan_checkpoint, IMPLEMENT/REPAIR, REVIEW, REBUT and PACKAGE, lines 2033-3276), not only the preflight/cell_up calls. Any other unhandled exception from those later phases, for example a bug or an unexpected API or git failure unrelated to rate limiting, also lands here and gets labelled ORPHANED, so the comment's claim that only Ctrl-C or a dead runtime reach this branch is narrower than what the code actually catches. No gate checks comment accuracy, only its length and style.
